page.overview:
What is Darkling Plains?

The Darkling Plains were flatlands in Golthonor on the continent of Corondor on Dominaria.

They are home to the nomadic war tribes of Golthonor. From this endless scrub great armies can be raised...and chaos unleashed. The plains were used as a battleground for warlords such as Warlord Mandek Ironfist.

A subregion, the Plains of Coloni were the plains nearest to the Great Salt Marshes. Altair of Coloni was from this area.
